name: clickup-active-task-bar
title: ClickUp Active Task Bar
description: Show a sticky active ClickUp task in the Raycast menu bar.
author: lemonbottle

preferences.name: teamId
preferences.title: Workspace ID
preferences.description: Your ClickUp workspace ID. ClickUp's API still calls this team_id in v2 endpoints.

preferences.name: viewIdOrUrl
preferences.title: View ID, URL, or Name
preferences.description: Paste a ClickUp view ID, a full view URL, or the exact name of an Everything-level workspace view.

preferences.name: titleLength
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title Length
preferences.description: Maximum number of characters to show in the menu bar label before truncating.

preferences.name: showClosedTasks
preferences.title: Closed Tasks
preferences.description: Include closed tasks from the fetched view in the menu.
preferences.label: Show closed tasks

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Show Active Task
commands.subtitle: ClickUp
commands.description: Show and switch your current ClickUp task from the menu bar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
